sourceDate.text: 條侯亞夫自未侯為河內守時
條侯子為父買工官尚方甲楯
景帝乃更封絳侯勃他子堅

claims.action: destroyed the Lu clan and enthroned Emperor Wen

claims.assessment: plain-spoken, steadfast, and honest; trusted with great affairs

claims.action: held strict discipline at Xiliu; praised by Emperor Wen

claims.manner: starvation after refusing food five days; vomited blood

claims.statement: vertical crease running into the mouth (starvation physiognomy)

claims.assessment: saved the state from the Lu clan; comparable to Yi Yin and the Duke of Zhou
stern authority in command; self-satisfied and obstinate, ending in ruin

claims.action: guilty of substandard tribute gold; marquisate abolished

item.en: five hundred suits of armor and shields

claims.action: implicated in illicit purchase of burial armor; interrogated

translationRepairs: He then turned his forces elsewhere and captured the Governor of Yunzhong, Su, along with the chancellor jisi and the general Xun.
He then turned his forces elsewhere and captured the Governor of Yunzhong, Su, along with the chancellor Ji Si and the general Xun.
丞相箕肆 names the chancellor 箕肆; lowercase "jisi" misformats that personal name, and "Ji Si" restores standard capitalization without changing meaning.
appointed Hedong governor Yafu as general, stationed at Xiliu: to prepare against the Xiongnu.
appointed Henei governor Yafu as general, stationed at Xiliu: to prepare against the Xiongnu.
The Chinese has 河內守, which is Henei, not Hedong (河東); the literal's "Hedong" is a place-name error, and the idiomatic already correctly has Henei.
Even yiyin and the Duke of Zhou could scarcely have done more!
Even Yi Yin and the Duke of Zhou could scarcely have done more!
伊尹 is the personal name Yi Yin; lowercase "yiyin" is an incorrect rendering of that name, and "Yi Yin" matches standard English usage alongside 周公 as the Duke of Zhou.
Even yiyin and Zhou Gong, what could surpass this!
Even Yi Yin and Zhou Gong, what could surpass this!
The same 伊尹 in the literal must be "Yi Yin," not lowercase "yiyin"; the proposed fix corrects the name without altering the rest of the calque.
